Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 10
Reason for Mistake: The Planner incorrectly synthesized the extracted data from the Wikipedia page. While the Wikipedia infobox and text explicitly stated Benjamin Millepied was "Born: 10 June 1977, Bordeaux, France" and described him as a "French dancer," the Planner erroneously concluded he was "from the United States" and a "naturalized American citizen." This is a direct contradiction of the evidence presented in the very source the Planner just analyzed. The error represents a failure to correctly map the explicit "Born in France" data to the question "Which country... is he from?", instead hallucinating a US origin despite the clear French birthplace and nationality indicators in the text.
